text:
kai: Heads-up: small but nasty bug in Next middleware on Vercel preview. SDK import causes middleware to crash with "TypeError: Response.prototype.arrayBuffer is not a function". Local next dev is fine. Anyone seen this?
frances: Yup. Usually resolver picks a node-y build or a shim landed in the bundle. SWC can inline a tiny polyfill that breaks the worker Fetch surface.
leo: In one project we had `logger.js` require('util').inspect at module scope. That triggered SWC to pull node util into the edge bundle and mutated globals. Moving logger behind a dynamic import fixed it.
leo: Pattern we used: if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.release?.name === 'node') { await import('./node-logger') }
zara: Another angle is exports resolution. If bundler resolves the package to the CJS main instead of an edge esm build, you'll see runtime differences. Add an explicit ./edge export pointing to dist/edge.mjs so edge consumers can import 'pkg/edge'.
kai: That matches my quick hack. Importing 'redwood-inference/edge' directly inside middleware made the crash go away, but TypeScript still complains in the middleware file: "Cannot find name 'Request'" and some types reference Buffer.
frances: For TS: ship edge.d.ts that references DOM libs only and avoid Node types in the public surface. Also add docs with a tsconfig.middleware.json snippet: { "lib": ["esnext", "dom"] } so Next's middleware compile has the right libs.
leo: We also split typings: index.d.ts (node/server) and edge.d.ts (web/worker). The build script emits both and package.json exports map points to the correct .d.ts for ./edge.
zara: Runtime gotcha: retry/backoff used setTimeout which doesn't behave in worker-style edges. Replace with AbortController + Promise.race deadline or use signal.timeout. That fixed hung retries for us.
kai: Good call. My auth refresh was hanging in preview. Switching to AbortController resolved it.
frances: CI change: add a small static check that scans dist/edge.mjs for forbidden imports (fs|child_process|util|crypto.randomBytes). Fail the edge build if any are reachable. Caught a regression for us.
build-bot: ci/edge-sanity: failed on main -> dist/edge.mjs includes util.inspect via logger.
leo: Short-term fixes we can ship: 1) dist/edge.mjs export in package.json, 2) emit dist/edge.d.ts (web-only types), 3) lazy-load node-only modules, 4) switch edge build retry to AbortController. Patch release ETA: tomorrow afternoon.
kai: I'll attach a tiny repro middleware to the issue and validate the preview once the patch lands. Thanks everyone.
